drum_performances.name: Uriel Jones
drum_performances.why_it_matters: Drew Schultz remixed the stereo track to spotlight the drums: the funkiest of his records.

evidence.note: Credited to Jones by drummers (Drew Schultz, Aaron Reinhard, Jeff Tripoli), not by a discography.

drums.description: The kick on 1 one bar and its "and" the next, then 3 and the "and"s of 3 and 4; a soft snare on the "a" of 2; in the refrains the snare walking on every third sixteenth. At 124.

evidence.note: Credited to Jones by drummers (Drew Schultz, Aaron Reinhard, Jeff Tripoli), not by a discography.

transcriptions.note: Aaron Reinhard's full drum transcription (for sale, not read): Uriel Jones, 124, 4/4
